readme: # KeepInventory A simple V Rising server mod that **prevents players from dropping their inventory on death**. > ⚠️ **Note:** This is a **global mod** and affects **all players on the server**. > Per-player configuration is **not available** at this time. --- ## Support & Donations --- ## Installation ### Requirements This mod requires the following dependency: * **[BepInEx](https://wiki.vrisingmods.com/user/bepinex_install.html)** - Modding framework for V Rising ### Manual Installation 1. Download the latest release of **ScarletCore** from Thunderstore 2. Extract the contents into your `BepInEx/plugins` folder: ``` /BepInEx/plugins/ ``` Your folder should now include: ``` BepInEx/plugins/ScarletCore.dll ``` 3. Start or restart your server
